column6: Definition (EN)
Regular periodic stock count (monthly, quarterly, annual).
Unscheduled count, e.g. after an audit, incident or change of the responsible person.
First load of stock balances when a facility or system starts reporting to DHP.
Goods received from a supplier, procurement or central distribution.
Stock received from another warehouse, facility or department.
Stock sent to another warehouse, facility or department.
Unused items returned to stock from a department, patient or user.
Items returned to the supplier or distributor.
Items dispensed to patients, used in care or transfused.
Items removed because their expiry date has passed.
Items removed because of damage or broken storage conditions (e.g. cold chain).
Items removed after failing quality control, lab screening (blood) or a regulatory ban.
Items withdrawn due to a manufacturer or regulator recall.
Items missing, lost or stolen; shortage found during a count.
A count found more items than were recorded.
Correction of an earlier data-entry or reporting error.
Items received as a donation, humanitarian aid or grant.
Physical destruction or disposal of items already written off.
Medical equipment (JihozMed) permanently taken out of service.
Blood or blood components collected from donors (Blood Service).
Reason not listed; explain in operationTypeReason.text or note.
